requirement_match.summary: Approved progressive sizing, reversal, shared mobile menu and privacy override verified by six focused Playwright checks.

security.summary: Scoped numeric CSS progress only; existing links, authentication, consent, APIs, storage and dependencies preserved. No secrets or external requests introduced.

code_quality.summary: Focused ESLint and full tsc --noEmit passed. rAF batches passive scroll events, progress writes avoid React rerenders, footprint reservation keeps content position stable. Chromium, mobile WebKit, Firefox and desktop WebKit checks passed.

failure_paths.summary: Progress clamps to bounds; reverse scrolling and live reduced-motion preference updates pass; open-menu freeze and close resync pass. Desktop no-JavaScript navigation verified. Hydration defaults retain original height.

error_handling.summary: Optional DOM ref access is safe; scroll/media listeners removed and pending frame cancelled on effect cleanup. No new asynchronous network or error surface. Mobile route navigation from an intermediate scroll position passed.

production_readiness.summary: Scoped local preview change is validated and rollback is confined to task hunks. No migrations or environment changes needed. This dimension assesses local implementation only; full production build/release and deployed behavior are NOT_TESTED.

trade_offs.summary: Height changes require layout; reserved margin prevents content shift and scroll anchoring feedback. Scroll drives progress directly without delayed easing. No 60fps or device-performance claim. Existing surface easing retained; reduced motion skips interpolation and decorative scaling.

residual_risks: Real-device frame pacing and complete site-wide release gates not tested.
limitations: Runtime ledger CLI/package unavailable; current review and rendered report recorded as repository artifacts without a runtime receipt.
Existing unrelated WIP retained; hashes identify the tested complete files, not a clean release candidate.
